battle.name: 赤瓜礁海戰
battle.brief: 1988年3月14日，中國海軍502、531、556三艘護衛艦在赤瓜礁與越南HQ-505、HQ-604、HQ-605三艦對峙。8時47分接火，越方604號運輸船中彈沉沒，505號登陸艦重創擱淺鬼喊礁，605號運輸船當晚沉沒；中方僅一人輕傷，赤瓜礁及南沙六個島礁落入中方控制。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰雙方是中國人民解放軍海軍南海艦隊與越南人民軍海軍，衝突發生在中國宣稱擁有主權、越南稱為「長沙群島」的南沙群島九章群礁一帶。中方以海軍榆林基地作為前進指揮點，基地司令員楊玉書坐鎮，參謀長陳偉文出任502護衛艦編隊總指揮，指揮艦隊在永暑礁、華陽礁、南薰礁與赤瓜礁之間交替巡邏；南海艦隊與東海艦隊先後投入502、503、510、531、552、553、556等護衛艦，南寧號導彈驅逐艦、西昌號護衛艦與南拖147號拖船負責掩護與運輸，後方還有在永暑礁施工高腳屋的工程部隊，以及海南島方向的岸基反艦力量作遠端牽制。越方由海軍司令部統籌，金蘭灣前進指揮所負責南沙方向的具體調度，海軍副司令黃友泰中將與第4軍區司令員兼前指司令甲文綱中將分居兩地，171艦隊與125運輸旅為投入南沙的骨幹，851號掃雷艦與614號運輸船亦參與華陽礁方向的對峙。雙方編制邏輯相同：以護衛艦編隊作掩護，以登陸艦和武裝運輸船送人上礁建屋，一旦對方介入即就地對峙或還擊，屬低強度、爭奪礁盤控制權的有限交戰，與中越邊境衝突的大框架直接相連。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the South Sea Fleet of the People's Liberation Army Navy of China and the People's Navy of Vietnam, the clash taking place on Chigua Reef in the Spratly group, which China claims and which Vietnam calls the Truong Sa archipelago. On the Chinese side the forward command post was the Navy's Yulin base, with base commander Yang Yushu holding it and chief of staff Chen Weiwen serving as overall commander of the 502 frigate task group, which patrolled in turn around Yongshu, Huayang, Nanxun and Chigua reefs. The South Sea Fleet and the East Sea Fleet put the frigates 502, 503, 510, 531, 552, 553 and 556 into the area, with the missile destroyer Nanning, the frigate Xichang and the tug Nantuo-147 providing cover and transport, while the construction unit building high-foot houses on Yongshu Reef worked behind them and shore-based anti-ship strength on Hainan Island provided long-range containment. On the Vietnamese side the Navy General Staff ran the operation and the Cam Ranh forward command post handled the Spratlys in detail; Lieutenant General Ho Hieu Thai, deputy commander of the navy, and General A Van Cuong, commander of the 4th Military Region and of that forward post, held the two ends of the chain, with the 171st Flotilla and the 125th Transport Brigade forming the core of the effort and the minesweeper 851 and the transport 614 also taking part in the stand-off off Huayang Reef. Both sides followed the same pattern of organisation: frigate groups screen, landing ships and armed transports carry men ashore to build high-foot houses, and the moment the other side intervenes the position is either held or answered with fire. It was a low-intensity, limited contest fought for control of a reef platform rather than a general war, and it hung directly on the wider framework of the Sino-Vietnamese border conflict.
people: 中方一線指揮由陳偉文主持，他當時是南海艦隊榆林基地參謀長，事後以少將身分接受回憶訪談，把交戰的每一個時點記錄下來：登礁人數、起火時刻、射擊距離與停火時機。基地司令員楊玉書負責整個南沙方向的力量調度。502南充艦政委李楚群帶領7名士兵駕小艇靠近礁盤，砍斷繫住越軍登礁小艇的纜繩，切斷越南人把裝備送上礁的通道；531鷹潭艦反潛兵班長杜祥厚在礁盤上拔走插著的越南國旗，奪旗過程中雙方逼近到數米之內；502艦副槍炮長楊志亮在爭奪中用手推開越軍已瞄準的槍支，左臂中彈，成為全場唯一一名負傷的中方人員。越方最高層是海軍副司令黃友泰中將坐鎮司令部，前進指揮所司令甲文綱中將在金蘭灣一線指揮。直接捲入交火的是125運輸旅副旅長陳德聰中校、HQ-604運輸船艦長武飛儲大尉，兩人在作戰中陣亡；HQ-605艦長黎令山大尉與HQ-505登陸艦艦長武輝禮大尉則在艦上指揮撤退與搶灘。越南方面在1990年代把此役定名為「長沙海戰」與「鬼鹿角礁事件」，此後每年以64名烈士的名義舉行悼念儀式，把陣亡者一一編號立傳。
peopleEn: Command on the Chinese side was exercised by Chen Weiwen, then chief of staff of the South Sea Fleet's Yulin base, who later gave interviews as a rear admiral and recorded the timing of every stage of the fight: the number of men put ashore, the moment the ship caught fire, the range of fire and the moment shooting stopped. Base commander Yang Yushu handled the allocation of force across the whole Spratly theatre. Political commissar Li Chuqun of the frigate 502 took seven soldiers round in a boat to the reef and cut the mooring lines holding the Vietnamese landing craft, closing the channel by which the enemy ferried gear onto the platform. Du Xianghou, the antisubmarine section leader of the frigate 531, pulled the Vietnamese national flag off the reef during the struggle for it, the two sides coming within a few metres of one another in the process. Yang Zhiliang, the deputy gunnery officer of the 502, pushed aside a Vietnamese rifle already aimed at him during the scramble over the flag and was shot through the left arm, becoming the only Chinese serviceman wounded in the action. On the Vietnamese side the senior figures were Lieutenant General Ho Hieu Thai, deputy commander of the navy, who stayed at headquarters, and General A Van Cuong, commander of the 4th Military Region and of the Cam Ranh forward post, who directed from Cam Ranh. Those pulled directly into the fighting were Lieutenant Colonel Tran Duc Thong, deputy commander of the 125th Transport Brigade, and Captain Vu Phi Chu, commander of the transport HQ-604, both of whom were killed; Captain Le Ling Shan, commander of HQ-605, and Captain Vu Huy Le, commander of the landing ship HQ-505, directed the withdrawal and the beaching from aboard their own ships. Vietnam in the 1990s named the action the 'Truong Sa naval battle' and the 'Gac Ma incident', and has since held an annual commemoration for the 64 martyrs, each of whom was numbered and given a place in the national record.
kits: 作戰序列裡沒有一艘鐵甲艦，卻處處是鐵甲艦定下的規矩。1860年代英國開造的鐵甲艦以木殼外包鐵甲帶，第一次令裝甲比砲更難對付，砲塔的火控與射界自此繞著裝甲設計；這條技術路線一路傳到1988年的南海。中方三艘護衛艦全是鋼殼：502南充艦屬65型，北約代號「江南」級，標準排水量1150噸，最大航速22節，裝3門100公厘砲、4座雙聯37公厘防備砲與14.5公厘機槍；531鷹潭艦屬053K型「江東」級，標準排水量1674噸，最大航速30節，配雙聯100公厘砲兩座、雙聯37公厘砲四座，另設兩座雙聯「紅旗」61型防空導彈發射架；556湘潭艦屬053H1型「江湖II」級，標準排水量1565噸，最大航速26節，同樣是雙聯100公厘砲兩座、雙聯37公厘砲四座，另設兩座雙聯「上游」1型反艦導彈發射架。值得注意的是，531與556當時都屬實驗性裝備，防空與反艦導彈發射架均未裝彈。越方三艘同樣是鋼殼：HQ-505「歸仁」登陸艦是二次大戰美製LST-509，標準排水量1651噸，最大航速僅12節，裝4座雙聯40公厘砲；HQ-604與HQ-605為武裝運輸船，排水量368噸、滿載822噸，只配14.5公厘KPV重機槍。雙方船殼都靠鋼板與縱向艙壁分區抗彈，命中後最怕的不是穿孔，而是水線進水、炮位被毀與火控失效；這正是鐵甲艦時代用裝甲帶、火控室冗餘與水線防護解決的同一個問題，只是1988年的答案已換成反艦導彈、衛星定位與精密射擊。
kitsEn: Not one ironclad was in the order of battle, yet the rules ironclads created were everywhere. British ironclads of the 1860s put iron armour over a wooden hull and for the first time made armour harder to defeat than guns, and from then on gun turret control and firing arcs were designed around the armour; that line of technical development ran straight to the South China Sea in 1988. All three Chinese frigates were steel hulls. The 502 Nan Chong belonged to Type 65, the NATO 'Jiangnan' class, standard displacement 1,150 tonnes, maximum speed 22 knots, armed with three 100 mm guns, four twin 37 mm anti-aircraft mounts and 14.5 mm machine guns. The 531 Ying Tan was a Type 053K 'Jiangdong' class frigate, standard displacement 1,674 tonnes, maximum speed 30 knots, with two twin 100 mm gunhouses, four twin 37 mm mounts and two twin launchers for HQ-61 surface-to-air missiles. The 556 Xiang Tan was a Type 053H1 'Jianghu II' class frigate, standard displacement 1,565 tonnes, maximum speed 26 knots, again with two twin 100 mm gunhouses and four twin 37 mm mounts, plus two twin launchers for the 'Shangyou' Type 1 (C-801) anti-ship missile. One point stands out: the 531 and the 556 were both experimental fittings, and neither the air-defence nor the anti-ship launchers carried missiles on the day. The three Vietnamese ships were steel as well. The landing ship HQ-505 Quyen was the American LST-509 of the Second World War, standard displacement 1,651 tonnes, a maximum speed of only 12 knots, armed with four twin 40 mm mounts. HQ-604 and HQ-605 were armed transports of 368 tonnes displacement and 822 tonnes full load, fitted only with 14.5 mm KPV heavy machine guns. Both sides' hulls relied on steel plating and longitudinal bulkheads to survive hits, and what a ship feared was not so much perforation as flooding below the waterline, the destruction of a gun position and the failure of fire control. These are exactly the problems that the armour belt, the redundant fire-control room and the under-waterline protection of the ironclad era were built to solve, except that by 1988 the answers had become anti-ship missiles, satellite navigation and precision gunnery.
tactics: 整場交火從接觸到撤離不足兩個鐘頭，節奏極緊。3月12日越南以HQ-505、HQ-604、HQ-605三艦運送117名武裝人員赴赤瓜礁建高腳屋；3月13日6時502南充艦先行出動，14時25分抵達並派人上礁插旗，傍晚越方三艦分別在鬼喊礁（赤瓜礁西北1.5海里）、赤瓜礁本礁與瓊礁（東北5海里）拋錨，一南一北夾住中國的礁盤。3月14日6時30分531鷹潭艦、6時44分556湘潭艦抵達，502、531、556三艦由陳偉文統一指揮；同一時間趁低潮，越軍由HQ-604派出43人登礁，中方502艦派33人、531艦派25人，共58人上礁，8時在礁盤上形成對峙。8時47分手槍與機槍互射，8時48分502艦開火還擊，4分鐘後604號起火、8分鐘後沉沒。另一側，531艦在距505登陸艦約30鏈（約555公尺）處與之對射，因炮口後座使主炮火控雷達故障，全艦共出故障54起，射擊數十發即中止；502艦隨即調轉炮口支援，505艦體起火、炮位被毀，為免沉沒在鬼喊礁搶灘擱淺。9時15分556艦在瓊礁方向攻擊605號，9時37分停射，605號當晚沉沒。戰術特徵是潮汐窗口內的近距離礁盤爭奪：先用小艇接舷、砍纜、拔旗等動作逼對方先動手，再由艦砲在數百公尺內一次解決。編隊在戰鬥結束後立即外海機動，因當時解放軍空軍無法有效支援南沙，而越方在金蘭灣具備反擊能力，雙方都避免把衝突升級成殘酷的消耗戰。
tacticsEn: The whole action from first contact to withdrawal took less than two hours, and the tempo was tight. On 12 March Vietnam sent the three ships HQ-505, HQ-604 and HQ-605 carrying 117 armed men to Chigua Reef to build high-foot houses. At 06:00 on 13 March the frigate 502 Nan Chong sailed first, arrived at 14:25 and put men ashore to plant the flag. That evening the three Vietnamese ships anchored respectively at Gac Ma Reef, one and a half nautical miles north-west of Chigua, at the reef itself, and at Qiong Reef five nautical miles to the north-east, closing on the Chinese position from north and south. The 531 Ying Tan arrived at 06:30 on 14 March and the 556 Xiang Tan at 06:44, and the group of 502, 531 and 556 was commanded by Chen Weiwen. At the same time, taking advantage of low water, the Vietnamese put 43 men ashore from HQ-604, while China sent 33 from the 502 and 25 from the 531, 58 in all, and the two sides stood facing each other on the platform at 08:00. Rifles and machine guns traded fire at 08:47; the 502 opened fire in reply at 08:48; HQ-604 was burning four minutes later and had foundered eight minutes after that. On the other arc the 531 engaged the landing ship HQ-505 at a range of about 30 chains, roughly 555 metres, but the recoil of the guns knocked out the main fire-control radar, the ship logged 54 faults in all and stopped firing after a few dozen rounds; the 502 then swung its guns onto the same target, and the 505 caught fire, lost its gun positions and, to keep from sinking, was beached on Gac Ma Reef. At 09:15 the 556 attacked HQ-605 in the Qiong Reef sector and stopped shooting at 09:37; HQ-605 sank that night. Tactically it was a contest for a reef platform fought at close range inside a tidal window: boat work such as cutting mooring lines, closing alongside and pulling down flags was used to force the other side to fire first, and naval gunfire then settled the matter within a few hundred metres. The task group manoeuvred out to open water immediately after the action, because the Chinese air force could not effectively support the Spratlys while the Vietnamese base at Cam Ranh was able to strike back, so neither side let the clash escalate into a brutal war of attrition.
data: 可查到的數字集中在火力與距離兩端。時間：1988年3月14日，礁上接火8時47分，射擊結束約9時37分，歷時不足一小時。兵力：中國3艘護衛艦（502、531、556）加後方待命兵力，越方3艘艦艇（HQ-505、HQ-604、HQ-605）；登礁兵力為越軍43人對中方58人，其中502艦33人、531艦25人。排水量與火力：502為1150噸、22節、3門100公厘砲；531為1674噸、30節、雙聯100公厘砲兩座；556為1565噸、26節、雙聯100公厘砲兩座；越方505為1651噸、12節、4座雙聯40公厘砲，604與605各368噸、滿載822噸。交火距離：531與505之間約30鏈，約555公尺。彈藥消耗：中國3艦共發射100公厘砲彈285發、37公厘砲彈266發。故障：531全艦共發生故障54起，主炮火控雷達因炮彈後座震動而失效。傷亡：中方1人輕傷、艦艇零損失；中方統計越軍死亡40餘人、被俘40餘人，因艦隊外海機動未能及時接收俘虜，最後只餘9人移交，其中含1名中校軍官；越方以64名烈士立碑緬懷，另有11人受傷的說法。戰損：越方HQ-604沉沒，HQ-605中彈起火後當晚沉沒，HQ-505重創後在鬼喊礁擱淺，同年7月12日拖帶時沉沒。航程上，榆林基地至赤瓜礁是數百海里量級，全程靠艦隊自帶油彈維持，沒有海上補給。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers cluster around firepower and range. Timing: 14 March 1988, contact on the reef at 08:47, firing finished around 09:37, an action of under an hour. Forces: three Chinese frigates (502, 531, 556) with reserves in rear against three Vietnamese vessels (HQ-505, HQ-604, HQ-605); 43 Vietnamese and 58 Chinese were put ashore, 33 from the 502 and 25 from the 531. Displacement and armament: the 502 at 1,150 tonnes, 22 knots, three 100 mm guns; the 531 at 1,674 tonnes, 30 knots, two twin 100 mm gunhouses; the 556 at 1,565 tonnes, 26 knots, two twin 100 mm gunhouses; the Vietnamese HQ-505 at 1,651 tonnes, 12 knots, with four twin 40 mm mounts, while HQ-604 and HQ-605 were 368 tonnes each and 822 tonnes full load. Range of the gun duel: about 30 chains, some 555 metres, between the 531 and the 505. Ammunition expended: the three Chinese ships fired 285 rounds of 100 mm and 266 rounds of 37 mm. Failures: 54 faults on the 531, with the main fire-control radar knocked out by the shock of the guns. Casualties: one wounded and no ship damage on the Chinese side; Chinese counts put Vietnamese dead at more than 40 and prisoners at more than 40, of whom only nine were actually handed over because the group withdrew before the surrender could be taken, one of them a lieutenant colonel; Vietnam has commemorated 64 martyrs and also speaks of 11 wounded. Losses: the Vietnamese transport HQ-604 sank, HQ-605 was hit, caught fire and sank that night, and HQ-505 was so badly damaged that it was beached on Gac Ma Reef and sank in tow on 12 July. In terms of logistics, the run from Yulin base to Chigua Reef is measured in several hundred nautical miles, and the whole sortie was sustained on fuel and ammunition carried by the ships themselves, with no underway replenishment.
cause: 直接導火線是南沙群島的實際控制權之爭。1984年3月19日的赤瓜礁衝突後，中越雙方在礁盤上互有勝負，越南海軍卻因蘇聯自1979年起無償借用金蘭灣作基地，具備向南海持續投射兵力、運輸人員與建材的能力，南沙方向的對峙從此長期化。中國這邊則找到一個制度性支點：1987年2月聯合國教科文組織政府間海洋學委員會第14次會議通過《全球海平面聯測計劃》，中國受委托建設5座海洋觀測站，其中編號第74號站選址永暑礁，1988年2月上旬海軍施工部隊開始在永暑礁建站並構築高腳屋。越南視之為中國取得南沙永久存在的鋪路，1月15日至2月19日先後由171艦隊、125運輸旅派員搶佔永暑礁周邊礁盤，2月18日在華陽礁、尹慶群礁一線與中方162南寧號、508西昌號對峙數日後撤退。3月12日，越方以三艘軍艦運送117名武裝人員前往赤瓜礁修屋；3月13日502艦上礁插旗，雙方都不肯退一步。中共中央高層為南沙鬥爭定下的原則是「不主動惹事、不首先開槍、不示弱、不吃虧、不丟面子，如果敵占我島嶼，要強行把他趕走」，這條原則決定了中方的戰術取向：守點、示強、逼對方先動手，再以火力一次解決，而不是主動擴大戰爭。而海上實際接觸的常態化，也讓1988年3月14日這場短兵相接，最終從礁盤爭執變成一次真正的海戰。
causeEn: The immediate spark was the contest over effective control of the Spratly reefs. After the Chigua Reef clash of 19 March 1984 the two sides had traded wins and losses on the platforms, but Vietnam, able since 1979 to use Cam Ranh Bay without charge as a Soviet base, could project ships, men and building material into the South China Sea continuously, and the stand-off in the Spratlys became a permanent feature. China, meanwhile, found an institutional foothold: in February 1987 the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO adopted the Global Sea Level Observing Plan, under which China was asked to establish five ocean observation stations, the number 74 of them sited at Yongshu Reef, and from early February 1988 the navy's construction unit began building the station and its high-foot houses there. Vietnam read this as a Chinese beachhead in the Spratlys, and between 15 January and 19 February the 171st Flotilla and the 125th Transport Brigade seized reefs around Yongshu, only pulling back on 18 February after several days of stand-off with the Chinese destroyer Nanning and frigate Xichang near Huayang and Trung Nhon reefs. On 12 March Vietnam sent three warships carrying 117 armed men to Chigua Reef to build, and on 13 March the 502 went ashore and planted the flag; neither side would give way. The principle set for the Spratly contest at the top of the Chinese leadership was to pick no quarrels, open no fire, show no weakness, take no loss and save no face, and to drive the enemy off any island he had occupied. That formula shaped Chinese tactics: hold the position, show strength, force the other side to move first, then settle it in one burst of firepower rather than widening the war. And because contact at sea had become routine, the brief clash of a few hundred seconds on 14 March 1988 turned from a quarrel over a reef into a real naval engagement.
impact: 對中國而言，這場戰役的實際意義是補上了主權宣示與實際控制之間的缺口。戰後中方穩住了永暑礁、華陽礁、東門礁、南薰礁、渚碧礁與赤瓜礁六個島礁，這是在南沙群島中第一次取得可以長期駐守的據點，後續的填海造島工程才有起點。越方則在鬼喊礁與瓊礁以傷艦搶灘的方式保住南北兩個支點，形成對赤瓜礁的夾擊格局，同時以64名烈士的說法把損失轉化為全國性的紀念敘事，並加速更新海軍裝備、尋求蘇聯以外的多邊支持與引進大中型水面艦艇。對中國海軍自身，這是一份代價極低而教訓極重的戰報：全場只傷一人、零艦損，卻暴露了主炮火控雷達因後座震動而失效、發射機構膛蝕嚴重、主力艦使用小時已到壽命、反艦與防空導彈發射架根本未裝彈、空軍支援半徑覆蓋不到南沙等一連串問題，陳偉文在往後多次受訪中談到這場戰役對中國海軍現代化、尤其是遠海作戰與航空支援的啟迪。外交上，中國向越南駐華使館遞交抗議照會，但整體低調處理；當時中西方正處蜜月期，除蘇聯外歐美各國多不置評，中越關係自1980年代中期的僵持逐步走向1990年代的正常化。鐵甲艦的技術譜系也在此時走到盡頭又接續：1862年前後，裝甲帶決定一艘船的生死；到1988年，決定生死的已是火控、雷達、導彈與補給體系。真正的海上角力則由對岸在1990年代之後的海軍擴建，重新拉回到這片海域。
impactEn: For China the practical meaning of the engagement was that it closed the gap between claiming sovereignty and actually controlling the ground. Afterwards Beijing held Yongshu, Huayang, Dongmen, Nanxun, Zhuobi and Chigua, the first six Spratly reefs on which it could garrison permanently, and the reclamation works that followed had their starting point. Vietnam kept two anchorages to the north and south by beaching the damaged ship at Gac Ma and holding Qiong Reef, forming a pincer on Chigua, and it turned the losses into a national commemorative narrative centred on 64 martyrs, while pressing ahead to re-equip the navy, to seek support beyond the Soviet Union and to acquire larger surface combatants. For the Chinese navy itself this was a battle report with trivial losses and heavy lessons: one man wounded and no ship damage, yet it exposed a chain of problems, from a main fire-control radar disabled by recoil shock and badly eroded gun barrels to machinery already at the end of its service hours, anti-ship and air-defence launchers fitted without any missiles at all, and an air force whose reach could not cover the Spratlys. Chen Weiwen returned to these lessons in later interviews, on the modernisation of the navy and especially on distant operations and air support. Diplomatically, China lodged a protest note with the Vietnamese embassy in Beijing but handled the matter with studied quiet; the West was in the middle of its honeymoon with China at the time and, apart from the Soviet Union, commented little, and Sino-Vietnamese relations moved from the stalemate of the mid-1980s towards the normalisation of the 1990s. The technical line of the ironclad also reached its end and its continuation: around 1862 the armour belt decided whether a ship lived or died, and by 1988 the deciding factors were fire control, radar, missiles and logistics. The real maritime contest was handed back to these waters by the naval expansion on the other side of the Taiwan Strait in the 1990s.
result: 結果清楚而慘烈。8時48分502南充艦向越方HQ-604運輸船開火還擊，四分鐘後該船起火、八分鐘後沉沒；604艦長武飛儲大尉與125運輸旅副旅長陳德聰中校陣亡，43名登礁人中有40多人表示投降。531鷹潭艦因火控雷達故障未能擊沉HQ-505，該艦被502艦補射後起火、炮位盡毀，勉強在鬼喊礁搶灘擱淺，7月12日拖帶時沉沒。556湘潭艦在9時15分攻擊瓊礁方向的HQ-605，擊毀其指揮台、令船體嚴重傾斜，9時37分停射，該船當晚沉沒。中方全場僅502艦副槍炮長楊志亮左臂中彈一人受傷，三艘護衛艦均無實質損傷，艦隊在戰鬥結束後立即撤出戰場，以免招來越方空軍自金蘭灣方向的空中支援。赤瓜礁由中方控制，越方則以搶灘的傷艦分別控制鬼喊礁與瓊礁，夾擊之勢成形。中國官方稱之為「南沙海戰」與「3·14海戰」，越南官方稱為「長沙海戰」或「鬼鹿角礁事件」，中越兩邊各自記載的傷亡數字相差甚遠，但擊沉兩艘、重創一艘、中方零艦損的結論，兩邊並無分歧。
resultEn: The outcome was clear and brutal. At 08:48 the frigate 502 Nan Chong opened fire on the Vietnamese transport HQ-604 in reply; the ship was burning four minutes later and had foundered eight minutes after that. Captain Vu Phi Chu of the 604 and Lieutenant Colonel Tran Duc Thong of the 125th Transport Brigade were killed, and more than 40 of the 43 men ashore offered to surrender. The 531 Ying Tan could not sink the HQ-505 because its fire-control radar had failed, and after the 502 added its own fire the ship caught fire, lost its gun positions and managed to beach itself on Gac Ma Reef, where it sank in tow on 12 July. At 09:15 the 556 Xiang Tan attacked HQ-605 in the Qiong Reef sector, wrecking its bridge and heeling the ship badly, and stopped shooting at 09:37; the ship sank that night. China lost one man, the left arm of the 502's deputy gunnery officer Yang Zhiliang, and all three frigates came through without material damage, the group withdrawing from the scene as soon as the action was over so as not to invite air strikes from the Vietnamese base at Cam Ranh. Chigua Reef fell under Chinese control, while Vietnam used the beached wreck to hold Gac Ma and Qiong Reef, completing the pincer. Chinese official sources call it the 'Nansha naval battle' or the '14 March naval battle'; Vietnamese official sources call it the 'Truong Sa naval battle' or the 'Gac Ma incident'. The casualty figures in the Chinese and Vietnamese accounts differ widely, but on the verdict that two Vietnamese ships were sunk, one was crippled and China lost no ships, the two accounts do not differ at all.
